_comment: Outlook connector trigger configuration for UiPath Maestro Flow.
uip maestro flow node configure <PROJECT>.flow <triggerId> --detail "$(cat trigger_detail.json)" --output json
Placeholders that require live-tenant resolution before running node configure:
connectionId  — UUID from: uip is connections list 'uipath-microsoft-outlook365' --all-folders --output json
folderKey     — Orchestrator folder key tied to that connection
(look for displayName 'Inbox' or the folder you want; use its 'id' field)
eventMode is set to 'polling' (Outlook email-received is a polling trigger).
If registry get returns 'webhooks' for your tenant, change eventMode accordingly.
Filter:     AND( from == 'abc@xyz.com',  subject contains 'good day' )
